lastResponse.text: Thank you for telling me. You did the right thing. Right now, call nine one one immediately. Again: nine one one. Tell them: “I’m three weeks postpartum, I had thoughts of hurting myself and I’m scared I could hurt my baby.” If you can, Place the baby in a safe spot like a crib, then stay on the line. If this call drops, call nine one one right back.
originalTexts: Thank you for telling me. You did the right thing. Right now, call **9-1-1** immediately. Again: **9-1-1**. Tell them: “I’m three weeks postpartum, I had thoughts of hurting myself and I’m scared I could hurt my baby.” If you can, place the baby in a safe spot like a crib, then stay on the line. If this call drops, call **9-1-1** right back.
